input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services")
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Clear Capital anywhere in the Agreement. The engagement is expressly task-by-task through individually agreed Statements of Work (§ 1(a)), with no requirements commitment, minimum volume, or prohibition on procuring comparable services from third parties; § 3 compensation is purely time-and-materials per SOW and is not tied to exclusive engagement. The only uses of "exclusive" are Contractor's ownership of its pre-existing materials (§ 4, p0020), a non-exclusive licence in our favour (p0021), and the entire-agreement clause (p0051) — none of which restrict our sourcing freedom. The sole restrictive covenant is a mutual non-solicitation of employees (p0047), which is not exclusivity. This meets the preferred position; no redline needed.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
